gate: GSE255671 remote RAW tar member-name inventory
permitted_operations: issue HTTP HEAD and byte-range requests against the frozen GEO RAW tar
read GNU long-name/PAX metadata payload only when necessary to recover file names
record archive member path, type and declared size
skip all ordinary member payload bytes
forbidden_operations: download or inspect ordinary biological file payloads
parse sequencing, expression, ATAC or ChIP values
choose a file based on biological values
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio or Bio Chi
pass_rule: remote server supports bounded range reads and tar headers can be traversed to end-of-archive with no ordinary member payload reads
fail_rule: range requests are unsupported, archive size drifts, header traversal is invalid, or ordinary member payload must be opened to identify source structure
